To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a statistical static timing analysis (SSTA) approach to estimate the yield of a circuit with respect to its timing constraints.

(1) the timing yield results based on our approach are close to Monte Carlo results; (2) the correlation between the longest and shortest path delay is not significant; (3) the correlation between path delays is not as significant as the spatial correlation; (4) the clock skew due to the process variation has a considerable impact on the timing yield; and (5) the impact of process variations on the circuit timing is different for different circuits

the proposed method can estimate circuit timing yield accurately, the timing yield is sensitive to clock skew and spatial correlation between path delays, and the correlation between longest path and shortest path delays can be neglected.

the statistical analysis of timing yield for high-performance circuits.
the timing yield of sequential circuits under process variations.
the statistical timing analysis of sequential circuits.
